Subject: Re: Velocity prod onboarding - intermittent auth retries

Hi Jonas / Camila,

We started the final validation run for the enterprise account (Region: us-east) and are seeing auth retries between Velocity and Redwood token exchange. Symptoms: 5-15s token handshake delays causing request retries; roughly 8% elevated error rate for embeddings calls over the past 45 minutes. Customers are seeing failed batches on large ingestion jobs.

We've attached the trace we collected and a small config diff we applied on our side. Can Redwood confirm whether this is a known token refresh throttling pattern or if your edge routing dropped some keepalives during our burst?

Immediate ask: can you route this to your on-call partner engineer and confirm the escalation path / SLA for partner integrations? We may need a temporary fallback model variant while we validate.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Integration Lead, Velocity AI

Elena — thanks for the heads up and the trace. I routed to on-call and pulled in Camila and Sergio. Quick notes:

- We see matching spikes from our edge for calls originating from velocity.ai IP block between 08:20-09:00 PT.
- Initial indicator is transient token-cache invalidation after a burst of parallel refreshes; we have a known mitigation (staggered refresh backoff + increased KV TTL) that usually resolves this within minutes.

Immediate plan:
1) I'm initiating a controlled rollback to the previously validated token-cache TTL for your tenant.
2) Sergio will open a PagerDuty incident and coordinate a hotfix if rollback isn't effective within 20 minutes.
3) Camila and I will align on a short-lived fallback routing to a lower-throughput model variant so your ingestion completes.

Can you confirm whether Velocity applied any client-side bulk refresh or retry changes in the last hour?
